h1.en: How Much Does an Abortion Cost in Washington DC in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta un Aborto en Washington DC en 2026?

subhero.en: Abortion costs range from $300 to $2,600 in Washington DC in 2026 for care through about 22 weeks, depending on the method (pill or surgical), gestational age, and whether care is provided at an independent clinic or a hospital outpatient department. Washington DC law sets no gestational limit, so abortion remains legally available statewide, and medication abortion typically costs $300 to $650 while surgical abortion costs $600 to $2,600.
subhero.es: El aborto cuesta entre $300 y $2,600 en Washington DC en 2026 para atencion hasta aproximadamente las 22 semanas, segun el metodo (pastilla o quirurgico), la edad gestacional y si la atencion se brinda en una clinica independiente o en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital. La ley de Washington DC no fija un limite gestacional; el aborto con medicamentos cuesta tipicamente $300 a $650 y el quirurgico $600 a $2,600.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, abortion in Washington DC costs $300 to $650 for medication abortion (the pill), $600 to $900 for first-trimester surgical abortion, and $900 to $2,600 for second-trimester surgical procedures through about 22 weeks, with costs rising by gestational week. Washington DC local law sets no gestational limit. Original Medicare and DC Medicaid cover abortion only in the narrow Hyde Amendment exceptions (rape, incest, or life endangerment), but ACA-compliant plans sold through DC Health Link are not restricted from covering abortion. Under the No Surprises Act, any DC clinic or hospital must provide a written Good Faith Estimate before your appointment if you are paying out of pocket.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, el aborto en Washington DC cuesta entre $300 y $650 para aborto con medicamentos (pastilla), $600 a $900 para aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre, y $900 a $2,600 para procedimientos quirurgicos en el segundo trimestre hasta aproximadamente las 22 semanas. La ley local de Washington DC no fija un limite gestacional. Medicare Original y Medicaid de DC cubren el aborto solo en las excepciones de la Enmienda Hyde (violacion, incesto o peligro para la vida), pero los planes ACA vendidos a traves de DC Health Link no tienen esa restriccion. Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier clinica u hospital de DC debe darle un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito antes de su cita si paga de su bolsillo.

introParagraphs.en: Washington DC does not impose a gestational limit on abortion in local law as of 2026, which makes the District one of the most accessible jurisdictions on the East Coast for patients traveling from Virginia, Maryland, and states further south. Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC offers medication abortion through about 11 weeks and in-clinic abortion through about 19 weeks and 6 days, and independent reproductive health clinics such as Washington Surgi-Clinic serve patients at later gestational ages. Because most patients in DC pay at an independent clinic, the abortion cost in Washington DC in 2026 depends mostly on gestational age rather than on insurance status.
introParagraphs.es: Washington DC no impone un limite gestacional al aborto en su ley local a partir de 2026, lo que convierte al Distrito en una de las jurisdicciones mas accesibles de la Costa Este para pacientes que viajan desde Virginia, Maryland y estados mas al sur. Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC ofrece aborto con medicamentos hasta aproximadamente las 11 semanas y aborto en clinica hasta aproximadamente las 19 semanas y 6 dias, y clinicas independientes como Washington Surgi-Clinic atienden a pacientes en edades gestacionales mas avanzadas.

introParagraphs.en: Published Planned Parenthood pricing in Washington DC has shown a medication abortion near $578 and in-clinic surgical abortion from about $578 to about $2,008 depending on gestational age, with sedation and additional medication adding up to $360 (2022 figures, the most recent published schedule). Telehealth providers serving patients physically located in DC advertise medication abortion from about $300 to $499. Patients comparing options should ask each provider for an itemized Good Faith Estimate that separates the procedure, sedation, lab work, ultrasound, and follow-up visit, since bundled and unbundled prices are hard to compare otherwise.
introParagraphs.es: Los precios publicados de Planned Parenthood en Washington DC han mostrado un aborto con medicamentos cercano a $578 y un aborto quirurgico en clinica desde aproximadamente $578 hasta $2,008 segun la edad gestacional, con sedacion y medicamentos adicionales de hasta $360 (cifras de 2022, el calendario publicado mas reciente). Los proveedores de telehealth que atienden a pacientes ubicados fisicamente en DC anuncian el aborto con medicamentos desde aproximadamente $300 a $499. Los pacientes deben pedir a cada proveedor un Estimado de Buena Fe detallado.

introParagraphs.en: Washington DC coverage rules differ from Virginia and Maryland in one important way. KFF reports that DC Medicaid restricts abortion coverage to Hyde Amendment exceptions because Congress limits how the District may spend its own local funds, while KFF also reports that private plans and the DC Health Link marketplace do not restrict abortion coverage. The sections below cover the abortion cost in Washington DC in 2026, what Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage pay, how to request a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act, and which self-pay options and abortion funds can reduce the bill. Abortion is not a USPSTF preventive service, so standard cost-sharing applies when a plan covers it.
introParagraphs.es: Las reglas de cobertura de Washington DC difieren de Virginia y Maryland en un aspecto importante. KFF informa que Medicaid de DC limita la cobertura del aborto a las excepciones de la Enmienda Hyde porque el Congreso restringe como el Distrito puede gastar sus propios fondos locales, mientras que los planes privados y el mercado DC Health Link no restringen la cobertura. Las secciones siguientes cubren el costo del aborto en Washington DC en 2026, lo que pagan Medicare Original y Medicare Advantage, y como solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas. El aborto no es un servicio preventivo de USPSTF, por lo que aplica el costo compartido estandar.

explanationParagraphs.en: Washington DC abortion cost in 2026 is shaped heavily by where the procedure takes place. Independent reproductive health clinics operate with lower overhead than hospital outpatient departments and compete on self-pay pricing. A first-trimester surgical abortion at an independent Washington DC clinic runs about $600 to $900 in 2026, while the same procedure billed through a hospital outpatient department can reach $1,500 or more. The hospital chargemaster rate includes facility fees, nursing staffing models, and provider-based billing overhead that freestanding clinics do not carry. Patients with a complicated medical history may be referred to a hospital for safety reasons, and in that case a Good Faith Estimate from the hospital is the best way to see the full facility, anesthesia, and professional charges up front.
explanationParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto en Washington DC en 2026 esta fuertemente determinado por el lugar donde se realiza el procedimiento. Las clinicas independientes operan con menos gastos generales que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales y compiten en precios de pago propio. Un aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre en una clinica independiente de Washington DC cuesta aproximadamente $600 a $900 en 2026, mientras que el mismo procedimiento facturado en un departamento ambulatorio del hospital puede llegar a $1,500 o mas. El precio de lista (chargemaster) del hospital incluye cargos de instalacion y costos generales que las clinicas independientes no tienen.

explanationParagraphs.en: Medication abortion cost in Washington DC is lower because the clinical encounter is simpler: a telehealth or office consultation, a prescription for mifepristone (HCPCS S0190) and misoprostol (HCPCS S0191), and a follow-up confirmation. The bundled service code S0199 covers the consultation and associated services but not the drugs, which are billed separately. Telehealth providers serving patients located in DC advertise $300 to $499, while in-person clinic visits at Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC have been published near $578 including medications. Hospital outpatient medication abortion, where offered, can run $800 to $1,500 because of facility fees.
explanationParagraphs.es: El costo del aborto con medicamentos en Washington DC es mas bajo porque el encuentro clinico es mas simple: una consulta por telehealth o en consultorio, una receta de mifepristona (HCPCS S0190) y misoprostol (HCPCS S0191), y un seguimiento. El codigo S0199 cubre la consulta y servicios asociados pero no los medicamentos, que se facturan por separado. Los proveedores de telehealth que atienden a pacientes ubicados en DC anuncian $300 a $499, mientras que las visitas presenciales en Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC se han publicado cerca de $578 incluyendo medicamentos.

explanationParagraphs.en: Washington DC patients paying cash should compare quotes from at least two clinic types before scheduling, because bundled prices differ on whether sedation, ultrasound, Rh testing, and pathology are included. The DC Abortion Fund provides direct financial assistance to patients in the District, and Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) in DC offer sliding-scale fees for many reproductive health services, although not every FQHC performs abortions. Patients at or below 100 percent of the federal poverty level may qualify for reduced or $0 fees at some sites; the federal poverty level page linked below shows the current thresholds.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los pacientes de Washington DC que pagan en efectivo deben comparar cotizaciones de al menos dos tipos de clinicas antes de programar, porque los precios agrupados difieren en si incluyen sedacion, ultrasonido, prueba de Rh y patologia. El DC Abortion Fund proporciona asistencia financiera directa a pacientes del Distrito, y los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC) de DC ofrecen tarifas en escala movil para muchos servicios de salud reproductiva, aunque no todos realizan abortos.

Los procedimientos en edades gestacionales mas avanzadas cuestan mas y se cotizan individualmente. Medicare Original y Medicaid de DC cubren el aborto solo en las excepciones de la Enmienda Hyde.

paragraphs.en: Original Medicare Part B covers abortion only under the Hyde Amendment exceptions: when the pregnancy results from rape or incest, or when a physician certifies the pregnancy endangers the patient's life. Covered care is subject to the standard 20% coinsurance after the 2026 Medicare Part B deductible of $283, and no Medicare Physician Fee Schedule rate applies to elective abortion in 2026. Medicare Advantage plans are not required to cover abortion beyond those exceptions, and most do not. Medigap policies pay the 20% Original Medicare coinsurance only for services Original Medicare covers, so they do not expand abortion coverage. For most Medicare beneficiaries in Washington DC seeking elective abortion, the cash price is the price.
paragraphs.es: Medicare Original Parte B cubre el aborto solo bajo las excepciones de la Enmienda Hyde: cuando el embarazo resulta de violacion o incesto, o cuando un medico certifica que el embarazo pone en peligro la vida de la paciente. La atencion cubierta esta sujeta al coseguro del 20% despues del deducible de la Parte B de $283 para 2026. Los planes Medicare Advantage no estan obligados a cubrir el aborto mas alla de esas excepciones, y la mayoria no lo hace. Las polizas Medigap pagan el coseguro del 20% solo por servicios que Medicare Original cubre.

paragraphs.en: Commercial and marketplace coverage in Washington DC is more permissive than Medicaid. KFF reports that private insurance and the DC Health Link marketplace do not restrict abortion coverage in 2026, so many ACA-compliant plans and employer plans cover abortion with the same deductible and coinsurance that apply to other outpatient procedures. High-deductible plans usually require the patient to meet the deductible first, which can make the cash price lower than the insurance price. Federal employee plans and some plans sold outside the District follow stricter rules. DC Medicaid, by contrast, is limited to the Hyde exceptions of rape, incest, and life endangerment. Call member services to confirm coverage, cost-sharing, and prior authorization before scheduling.
paragraphs.es: La cobertura comercial y del mercado en Washington DC es mas permisiva que Medicaid. KFF informa que los seguros privados y el mercado DC Health Link no restringen la cobertura del aborto en 2026, por lo que muchos planes ACA y de empleadores cubren el aborto con el mismo deducible y coseguro que otros procedimientos ambulatorios. Medicaid de DC, en cambio, se limita a las excepciones Hyde de violacion, incesto y peligro para la vida. Llame a servicios para miembros para confirmar la cobertura antes de programar.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any patient in Washington DC who is uninsured or choosing to pay out of pocket has the legal right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the provider before the abortion. For an appointment scheduled at least 10 business days out, the provider must furnish the Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before service. For an appointment scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the Good Faith Estimate must arrive at least 1 business day before service. It must include itemized expected charges, procedure codes (such as S0199 for medication abortion services), the provider's name and NPI, and the total expected cost. The federal consumer resource is at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente en Washington DC sin seguro o que elija pagar de su bolsillo tiene derecho a un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito antes del aborto. Para una cita programada con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, el proveedor debe entregarlo al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio; para una cita a 3 a 9 dias habiles, al menos 1 dia habil antes. El recurso federal esta en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Washington DC in 2026, follow these five steps: (1) Call the clinic or hospital and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that lists the procedure code, the facility fee, the professional fee, sedation or anesthesia, lab work, ultrasound, and the follow-up visit. (3) Provide your ZIP code, your confirmed gestational age, and any add-ons you expect, such as IV sedation. (4) Confirm the timing: 3 business days before service if scheduled 10 or more business days out, or 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate; if the final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Washington DC en 2026, siga estos cinco pasos: (1) Llame a la clinica u hospital e identifiquese como paciente de pago propio o sin seguro. (2) Solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito con el codigo del procedimiento, cargo de instalacion, cargo profesional, sedacion, laboratorio, ultrasonido y seguimiento. (3) Proporcione su codigo postal, su edad gestacional confirmada y cualquier servicio adicional. (4) Confirme el plazo: 3 dias habiles antes si la cita es a 10 o mas dias habiles, o 1 dia habil antes si es a 3 a 9 dias habiles. (5) Conserve el estimado; si la factura final lo excede en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

paragraphs.en: A Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Washington DC is not a guaranteed final bill. Common reasons the actual charges exceed the estimate include: additional ultrasound time to confirm gestational age, pathology specimen fees, IV sedation or anesthesia upgraded from local anesthesia, Rh immunoglobulin for Rh-negative patients, and follow-up visit charges not in the original estimate. If the final bill is $400 or more above the Good Faith Estimate, the patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. The No Surprises Act has no exemption for reproductive health services in the District.
paragraphs.es: Un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Washington DC no es una factura final garantizada. Las razones comunes por las que los cargos reales superan el estimado incluyen: tiempo adicional de ultrasonido, cargos de patologia, sedacion IV o anestesia mejorada desde anestesia local, inmunoglobulina Rh para pacientes Rh negativas y cargos de seguimiento no incluidos. Si la factura final es $400 o mas superior al estimado, la paciente tiene 120 dias desde la fecha de la factura para presentar una reclamacion en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

items.en: Gestational age: Washington DC abortion cost in 2026 rises roughly $100 to $300 per additional week in the second trimester. A medication abortion at 6 weeks costs $300 to $550; a 20-week D&E costs $1,500 to $2,600 at an independent clinic.
items.es: Edad gestacional: el costo del aborto en Washington DC en 2026 aumenta aproximadamente $100 a $300 por cada semana adicional en el segundo trimestre.

items.en: Procedure type: medication abortion (the pill) costs less than surgical aspiration, which costs less than D&E (dilation and evacuation). Medication abortion is typically available through about 10 to 11 weeks.
items.es: Tipo de procedimiento: el aborto con medicamentos (pastilla) cuesta menos que la aspiracion quirurgica, que cuesta menos que el LEC. El aborto con medicamentos esta disponible tipicamente hasta las 10 a 11 semanas.

items.en: Site of service: independent clinics charge 2 to 3 times less than hospital outpatient departments for the same procedure in 2026. The hospital chargemaster rate adds facility fees that independent clinics do not bill.
items.es: Sitio de servicio: las clinicas independientes cobran 2 a 3 veces menos que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales por el mismo procedimiento en 2026. El precio de lista (chargemaster) hospitalario agrega cargos de instalacion.

items.en: Independent clinic cash bundles: Washington DC independent clinics and telehealth providers typically quote a flat self-pay price that bundles the procedure, sedation, and basic lab work. Ask: 'What is your all-inclusive cash price, and do you offer income-based discounts?' Cash bundles at independent centers typically run 30 to 60 percent below hospital chargemaster cash prices.
items.es: Paquetes de pago en efectivo de clinicas independientes: las clinicas independientes y proveedores de telehealth de Washington DC tipicamente cotizan un precio plano de pago propio que agrupa el procedimiento, sedacion y laboratorio basico. Pregunte si ofrecen descuentos basados en ingresos.

items.en: Hospital chargemaster discount ask: uninsured patients scheduled at a Washington DC hospital outpatient department can ask for the hospital's self-pay or financial assistance policy, which often takes 20 to 60 percent off the chargemaster rate. Some hospitals apply it automatically; others require a written request before the appointment.
items.es: Descuento sobre el precio de lista hospitalario: los pacientes sin seguro programados en un hospital de Washington DC pueden pedir la politica de pago propio o asistencia financiera, que a menudo descuenta 20 a 60 por ciento del precio de lista. Algunos hospitales lo aplican automaticamente; otros requieren una solicitud escrita.

items.en: Sliding-scale FQHCs: Federally Qualified Health Centers in DC set fees by household size and income, and some services can be $0 at or below 100 percent of the 2026 federal poverty level. Not every FQHC performs abortions, so call ahead. DC Abortion Fund grants can cover part or all of a procedure; contact the fund early because money is limited.
items.es: FQHC con escala movil: los Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente en DC fijan tarifas segun el tamano del hogar y los ingresos, y algunos servicios pueden ser $0 en o por debajo del 100 por ciento del nivel de pobreza federal de 2026. No todos realizan abortos. Las ayudas del DC Abortion Fund pueden cubrir parte o todo el procedimiento.

items.en: Insurance status: DC Medicaid covers abortion only under Hyde exceptions, while ACA-compliant plans through DC Health Link and most employer plans may cover it with standard deductible and coinsurance. High-deductible plans can make the cash price lower than the insurance price, and prior authorization is sometimes required.
items.es: Estado del seguro: Medicaid de DC cubre el aborto solo bajo excepciones Hyde, mientras que los planes ACA de DC Health Link y la mayoria de los planes de empleadores pueden cubrirlo con deducible y coseguro estandar. Los planes de deducible alto pueden hacer que el precio en efectivo sea menor.

intro.en: Abortion billing in Washington DC can include unexpected line items, especially when a procedure is billed through a hospital rather than an independent clinic. Check for these errors before paying any bill:
intro.es: La facturacion del aborto en Washington DC puede incluir cargos inesperados, especialmente cuando se factura a traves de un hospital en lugar de una clinica independiente. Verifique estos errores antes de pagar cualquier factura:

items.en: Separate anesthesiologist or CRNA bill arriving weeks later: the No Surprises Act may protect you if the anesthesia provider was out-of-network at an in-network facility. Verify network status before paying.
items.es: Factura separada de anestesiologo o CRNA semanas despues: la Ley de No Sorpresas puede protegerla si el proveedor de anestesia estaba fuera de la red en una instalacion dentro de la red. Verifique antes de pagar.

items.en: Pathology laboratory fee billed separately: tissue sent for histological analysis generates a separate lab bill that should have appeared on your Good Faith Estimate if anticipated.
items.es: Cargo de patologia facturado por separado: el tejido enviado para analisis genera una factura de laboratorio que debio aparecer en su Estimado de Buena Fe si se anticipaba.

items.en: Hospital facility fee billed for a freestanding clinic visit: if the claim shows a hospital outpatient rate for a procedure done at an affiliated clinic, dispute the facility designation.
items.es: Cargo de instalacion hospitalaria por una visita a clinica independiente: si el reclamo muestra una tarifa hospitalaria para un procedimiento realizado en una clinica afiliada, dispute la designacion.

items.en: Ultrasound billed twice: once inside the abortion package and again as a standalone diagnostic charge. Ask for an itemized bill and request removal of the duplicate.
items.es: Ultrasonido facturado dos veces: una dentro del paquete de aborto y otra como cargo diagnostico separado. Pida una factura detallada y solicite eliminar el duplicado.

items.en: Rh typing or Rh immunoglobulin billed as a surprise lab encounter: both are routine pre-procedure items and should be itemized on the Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Tipificacion Rh o inmunoglobulina Rh facturada como cargo sorpresa: ambos son rutinarios y deben estar detallados en el Estimado de Buena Fe.

en.question: How much does an abortion cost without insurance in Washington DC in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance in Washington DC in 2026, medication abortion (the pill) costs $300 to $650 depending on whether you use telehealth or visit a clinic in person. First-trimester surgical abortion costs $600 to $900 at an independent clinic. Second-trimester surgical procedures range from $900 to $2,600 through about 22 weeks, rising with each additional week, and later gestational ages are quoted individually. Hospital outpatient departments often charge 2 to 3 times the independent clinic rate because of facility fees. Always request a written itemized Good Faith Estimate before your appointment.

en.question: What does Medicare or DC Medicaid pay for an abortion in 2026?
en.answer: Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, and Medigap cover abortion only under the Hyde Amendment exceptions: rape, incest, or a pregnancy that endangers the patient's life. Covered care carries 20% coinsurance after the 2026 Part B deductible of $283. KFF reports that DC Medicaid is also limited to Hyde exceptions in 2026 because Congress restricts how the District may use its local funds. There is no Medicare Physician Fee Schedule rate for elective abortion, so most beneficiaries and Medicaid enrollees pay the clinic's cash price unless an exception applies or an abortion fund helps.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in Washington DC?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act, any Washington DC provider must give you a written Good Faith Estimate if you are paying out of pocket. Call the clinic, identify yourself as self-pay, and ask for an itemized estimate covering the procedure code, sedation, lab fees, ultrasound, and follow-up care. If your appointment is 10 or more business days away, the estimate is due 3 business days before service. If it is scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, it is due 1 business day before. Keep the written estimate. If the final bill exceeds it by $400 or more, you have 120 days to file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to abortion in Washington DC?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act took effect January 1, 2022, and applies to health care providers and facilities nationwide, including reproductive health clinics and hospitals in Washington DC. It requires providers to give uninsured and self-pay patients a written Good Faith Estimate of expected charges before scheduled care. It also limits surprise out-of-network bills for emergency care and for out-of-network clinicians at in-network facilities. There is no exemption for abortion or other reproductive health services. Original Medicare and Medicaid enrollees have separate protections. The federal consumer resource is at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for an abortion in Washington DC?
en.answer: Call any Washington DC abortion provider before scheduling and say: 'I am paying out of pocket. What is your all-inclusive cash price for a medication abortion, or for a surgical abortion at my gestational age?' Ask whether the price includes sedation, lab work, ultrasound, pathology, and the follow-up visit, and whether the clinic offers income-based sliding-scale fees. Request the quote in writing as a Good Faith Estimate. Compare the cash price against your insurance deductible and coinsurance if you have coverage before deciding which to use. Quotes from two providers make differences in bundling easy to spot.

en.question: Can I negotiate an abortion bill after the fact in Washington DC?
en.answer: Yes. If your final bill exceeds the written Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you can file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim within 120 days of the bill date at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Even without an overage, many providers accept a reduction for cash-pay-now offers, typically 30 to 50 percent below the billed amount, and hospital billing offices can apply their chargemaster self-pay discount or financial assistance policy after the fact. Contact billing, explain you are self-pay, and ask about a hardship discount or payment plan. The DC Abortion Fund may also help with outstanding balances.

en.question: What is the difference between hospital and independent clinic abortion cost in Washington DC?
en.answer: In Washington DC in 2026, an independent clinic charges about $600 to $900 for a first-trimester surgical abortion, while a hospital outpatient department can charge $1,500 or more for the same procedure. The hospital's chargemaster rate includes facility overhead, staffing models, and provider-based billing that freestanding clinics do not carry. Medication abortion at an independent clinic or telehealth provider runs $300 to $650, while hospital outpatient billing can exceed $1,000. Ask whether the provider bills as an independent clinic or a hospital outpatient department, and request a Good Faith Estimate from each option before scheduling.

en.question: Will my insurance cover an abortion in Washington DC in 2026?
en.answer: Abortion is not a USPSTF preventive service, so standard cost-sharing applies when a plan covers it. KFF reports that private insurance and the DC Health Link marketplace do not restrict abortion coverage in 2026, so many ACA-compliant plans and employer plans cover it with the usual deductible and coinsurance. Federal premium tax credits cannot pay for the abortion-coverage portion of a premium. DC Medicaid and Original Medicare cover it only under Hyde exceptions. Review your Summary of Benefits and Coverage or call member services, and ask about prior authorization before scheduling.

en.question: What is the difference between medication abortion and surgical abortion in Washington DC?
en.answer: Medication abortion uses mifepristone followed by misoprostol and is available in Washington DC through about 10 to 11 weeks by telehealth or in-person visit, at a 2026 cost of $300 to $650. Surgical abortion uses vacuum aspiration in the first trimester or dilation and evacuation (D&E) in the second trimester, performed in a clinic with local anesthesia or sedation, at a 2026 cost of $600 to $2,600 through about 22 weeks. Medication abortion carries a small chance of incomplete abortion requiring follow-up aspiration. Both are highly effective, and the choice usually depends on gestational age and patient preference.

en.question: What financial help is available for abortion in Washington DC in 2026?
en.answer: The DC Abortion Fund provides direct financial assistance to patients in the District, and national funds reached through the National Abortion Federation hotline can help with out-of-area patients. Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC offers income-based discounts, and DC Federally Qualified Health Centers offer sliding-scale fees for many reproductive health services, though not all perform abortions. Hospital financial assistance policies can reduce a chargemaster bill by 20 to 60 percent. Contact funds early because money is limited, and request a written Good Faith Estimate so the fund knows the exact amount to cover.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta un aborto sin seguro en Washington DC en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro en Washington DC en 2026, el aborto con medicamentos (pastilla) cuesta entre $300 y $650 segun use telehealth o visite una clinica. El aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre cuesta $600 a $900 en una clinica independiente. Los procedimientos del segundo trimestre van de $900 a $2,600 hasta aproximadamente las 22 semanas, y las edades mas avanzadas se cotizan individualmente. Los hospitales a menudo cobran 2 a 3 veces mas por cargos de instalacion. Siempre solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito y detallado antes de su cita.

es.question: Que paga Medicare o Medicaid de DC por un aborto en 2026?
es.answer: Medicare Original Parte B, Medicare Advantage y Medigap cubren el aborto solo bajo las excepciones de la Enmienda Hyde: violacion, incesto o un embarazo que pone en peligro la vida de la paciente. La atencion cubierta tiene coseguro del 20% despues del deducible de la Parte B de $283 para 2026. KFF informa que Medicaid de DC tambien se limita a las excepciones Hyde en 2026 porque el Congreso restringe el uso de fondos locales del Distrito. No existe una tarifa de Medicare para el aborto electivo, por lo que la mayoria paga el precio en efectivo de la clinica.

es.question: Como solicito un Estimado de Buena Fe para un aborto en Washington DC?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier proveedor de Washington DC debe darle un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito si paga de su bolsillo. Llame a la clinica, identifiquese como paciente de pago propio y solicite un estimado detallado con el codigo del procedimiento, sedacion, laboratorio, ultrasonido y seguimiento. Si su cita es a 10 o mas dias habiles, el estimado es debido 3 dias habiles antes del servicio; si es a 3 a 9 dias habiles, 1 dia habil antes. Conserve el estimado. Si la factura final lo supera en $400 o mas, tiene 120 dias para presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica al aborto en Washington DC?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas entro en vigor el 1 de enero de 2022 y aplica a proveedores e instalaciones de salud en todo el pais, incluidas clinicas de salud reproductiva y hospitales de Washington DC. Exige que los proveedores den a los pacientes sin seguro o de pago propio un Estimado de Buena Fe escrito de los cargos esperados antes de la atencion programada. Tambien limita las facturas sorpresa fuera de la red. No hay exencion para el aborto ni otros servicios de salud reproductiva. El recurso federal esta en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion de pago en efectivo para un aborto en Washington DC?
es.answer: Llame a cualquier proveedor de aborto de Washington DC antes de programar y diga: 'Pago de mi propio bolsillo. Cual es su precio en efectivo completo para un aborto con medicamentos o quirurgico a mi edad gestacional?' Pregunte si incluye sedacion, laboratorio, ultrasonido, patologia y seguimiento, y si ofrece tarifas en escala movil segun ingresos. Pida la cotizacion por escrito como Estimado de Buena Fe. Compare el precio en efectivo con su deducible y coseguro si tiene cobertura antes de decidir cual usar.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de aborto despues del procedimiento en Washington DC?
es.answer: Si. Si su factura final supera el Estimado de Buena Fe escrito en $400 o mas, puede presentar una reclamacion de resolucion de disputas dentro de los 120 dias de la fecha de la factura en cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Incluso sin exceso, muchos proveedores aceptan una reduccion por pago en efectivo inmediato, tipicamente del 30 al 50 por ciento, y los hospitales pueden aplicar su descuento de pago propio sobre el precio de lista (chargemaster). Contacte a facturacion y pregunte por un descuento por dificultad financiera o un plan de pagos.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el costo de un aborto en hospital y en clinica independiente en Washington DC?
es.answer: En Washington DC en 2026, una clinica independiente cobra aproximadamente $600 a $900 por un aborto quirurgico del primer trimestre, mientras que un departamento ambulatorio del hospital puede cobrar $1,500 o mas por el mismo procedimiento. La tarifa hospitalaria incluye gastos generales de instalacion y facturacion como proveedor hospitalario. El aborto con medicamentos en una clinica independiente o por telehealth cuesta $300 a $650; en un hospital puede superar $1,000. Pida un Estimado de Buena Fe a cada opcion antes de programar.

es.question: Cubrira mi seguro un aborto en Washington DC en 2026?
es.answer: El aborto no es un servicio preventivo de USPSTF, por lo que aplica el costo compartido estandar cuando un plan lo cubre. KFF informa que los seguros privados y el mercado DC Health Link no restringen la cobertura del aborto en 2026, por lo que muchos planes ACA y de empleadores lo cubren con el deducible y coseguro habituales. Los creditos fiscales federales no pueden pagar la porcion de la prima destinada a esta cobertura. Medicaid de DC y Medicare Original lo cubren solo bajo excepciones Hyde. Revise su Resumen de Beneficios o llame a servicios para miembros.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre el aborto con medicamentos y el quirurgico en Washington DC?
es.answer: El aborto con medicamentos usa mifepristona seguida de misoprostol y esta disponible en Washington DC hasta aproximadamente las 10 a 11 semanas por telehealth o en persona, con un costo en 2026 de $300 a $650. El aborto quirurgico usa aspiracion al vacio en el primer trimestre o dilatacion y evacuacion (LEC) en el segundo trimestre, en una clinica con anestesia local o sedacion, con un costo en 2026 de $600 a $2,600 hasta aproximadamente las 22 semanas. Ambos son muy efectivos; la eleccion depende de la edad gestacional y la preferencia de la paciente.

es.question: Que ayuda financiera esta disponible para el aborto en Washington DC en 2026?
es.answer: El DC Abortion Fund brinda asistencia financiera directa a pacientes del Distrito, y los fondos nacionales a los que se llega por la linea de la National Abortion Federation pueden ayudar a pacientes de otras zonas. Planned Parenthood of Metropolitan Washington DC ofrece descuentos segun ingresos, y los FQHC de DC ofrecen tarifas en escala movil, aunque no todos realizan abortos. Las politicas de asistencia financiera hospitalaria pueden reducir una factura de precio de lista (chargemaster) entre 20 y 60 por ciento. Contacte a los fondos temprano y solicite un Estimado de Buena Fe por escrito.
